PS-04A.disambiguation: Not a form-fit-function replacement for PS-04; requires firmware >= 3.2. Completely distinct from PS-40 (Coolant Loop).

PS-04.disambiguation: Original pressure sensor installed prior to Revision 3.2. Suffered signal drift after ~18 months. Completely distinct from PS-40.

PS-40.disambiguation: NOT related to HPU discharge circuit. Do not confuse with PS-04 / PS-04A.

IV-21.notes: Must be OPEN prior to HPU startup.

PLC-03.reset_restriction: Do NOT reset controller while hydraulic pressure is above 50 bar.

Auxiliary Reservoir.notes: Introduced in training slide deck for Line 4/5 peak demand top-up; NOT covered in standard Operator Manual.

Tier 1.name: Absolute Authority (Engineering Change Notices)
Tier 1.rule: Overrides all prior manuals from effective date/revision.

Tier 2.name: Baseline Authority (Official Manuals & Registers)
Tier 2.rule: Authoritative standard specifications, valid unless superseded by Tier 1.

Tier 3.name: Historical / Superseded Documentation
Tier 3.rule: Represents pre-revision historical specifications; not valid for current post-3.2 units.

Tier 4.name: Informal / Low Trust Field Observations
Tier 4.rule: Anecdotal field notes with uncalibrated tools; never treated as official specification.

hpu_normal_operating_pressure.conditions: Software Revision >= 3.2, Series-7 units manufactured after 2024
hpu_normal_operating_pressure.historical_conditions: Software Revision < 3.2, units prior to revision 3.2

informal_observation.note: Field technician noted 175 bar on Line 4 local panel, but noted it was measured with an uncalibrated gauge and is unverified.

hpu_normal_operating_pressure.scope_applicability: Only applies to units manufactured after 2024 on rev >= 3.2; units running pre-3.2 firmware remain at 180 bar.

active_hpu_pressure_sensor.compatibility_note: PS-04A is NOT a form-fit-function replacement for PS-04; requires firmware >= 3.2.

A17.title: Hydraulic Pressure Low
A17.active_sensor: PS-04 prior to revision 3.2, PS-04A on revision 3.2 and later (updated per ECN-1058)
A17.action_standard: See Section 4 of Maintenance Manual AEG-MM-700
A17.action_if_persists_gt_10s: Run Shutdown Procedure 4.7 (close IV-21, confirm pressure decay, power OFF, tag out)

A18.title: Hydraulic Pressure High
A18.required_action: Stop the HPU. Do not restart until pressure relief is verified.

A19.title: Pressure Sensor Signal Invalid
A19.required_action: Replace sensor per Maintenance Manual Section 6.

hpu_prestart_prerequisites: Isolation valve IV-21 is fully OPEN
Emergency stop circuit is RESET (not latched)
Maintenance access panel is INSTALLED, CLOSED, and secured
Hydraulic fluid level is NORMAL (within sight glass band)

ecn1058_approver.question: Who approved engineering bulletin ECN-1058?
ecn1058_approver.reason: ECN-1058 lists ECN Number, Title, Effective, References, and Status ('Released'), but completely omits an approver or author field.

iv21_mtbf.question: What is the mean time between failures for the isolation valve IV-21?
iv21_mtbf.reason: The documentation corpus does not specify reliability or MTBF metrics for valve IV-21.

ps04a_max_temp.question: What is the maximum continuous operating temperature of PS-04A?
ps04a_max_temp.reason: Neither ECN-1042, the manuals, nor Appendix C specify a maximum continuous operating temperature rating for PS-04A.

voltage_sensor_calibration.question: What is the calibration interval for the electrical system diagram's voltage sensor?
voltage_sensor_calibration.reason: The electrical system diagram (AEG-DWG-E02) does not contain a voltage sensor; no calibration interval exists for this non-existent device.

supply_400v_3phase.question: Is the Aegis Series-7 HCS compatible with a 3-phase 400V supply?
supply_400v_3phase.reason: The system electrical schematic and component register specify a 480V incoming disconnect (Q1) and 480:120V control transformer (T1). A 400V supply is not supported by standard documentation.

slides.text: What is the HPU? The Hydraulic Power Unit is the heart of the press's hydraulic system. You'll sometimes hear techs call it the "hydraulic pack" or just "the unit" — same thing. It pulls fluid from the main reservoir and, on most Line 4/5 configurations, tops up from a smaller Auxiliary Reservoir during peak demand. Discharge pressure is what the controller watches to decide if the unit is running normally. Note: “Auxiliary Reservoir” is a Line 4/5-specific configuration detail and is not covered in the standard Operator Manual.

sections.title: Aegis Series-7 Hydraulic Control System — Operator Manual
paragraphs: Document AEG-OM-700, Revision 1 (superseded). Applies to software revisions 3.0 and 3.1 only.

sections.title: 1. Overview
paragraphs:
The Aegis Series-7 Hydraulic Control System provides closed-loop hydraulic pressure regulation
for industrial press lines. The system is built around the Hydraulic Power Pack, which supplies
pressurized fluid to the press circuit under the supervision of the Aegis Controller.

sections.title: 4. Starting the Hydraulic Power Pack
paragraphs: Hydraulic fluid level is within the normal band.
Turn the POWER selector to ON.

sections.title: 5. Normal Operating Ranges
paragraphs: Normal HPU discharge pressure is 180 bar, as measured by pressure sensor PS-04.

sections.title: 6. Alarms
paragraphs: See the Aegis Alarm Reference for alarm A17 (Hydraulic Pressure Low) and related codes.

This legacy export does not reflect ECN-1042 (PS-04 to PS-04A sensor change and pressure setpoint
update to 200 bar, effective software revision 3.2) or ECN-1058. Do not use this document as the
sole reference for units running software revision 3.2 or later.
